title: Create rent record with valid future period sets status to Requested
gherkin:
Feature: Requested-rent reservation semantics
  Scenario: Create rent record with valid future period
    Given a rentable item exists with ID "ITEM-001"
    And the current date is "2024-01-15"
    When I create a rent request for item "ITEM-001" from "2024-02-01" to "2024-02-15"

    And the rent status is "Requested"

E8 documents implementation progress and notes a discrepancy between older guidance and current rules. E12 and E15 flag documented gaps in delivery-lifecycle synchronization and requested-rent override semantics. E13 and E14 highlight a potential conflict: earlier cancellation tolerance language is missing from current rules. The operative context captures the default Requested-status behavior and validation rules directly supported by PRIMARY evidence. Exceptions capture the explicit past-period override clause. Conflicts and gaps are separated to distinguish between obsolete guidance and genuine uncertainties. E4 provides implementation context on availability calculation that directly supports the overlap-prevention rule. E12 and E15 flag documented gaps in delivery-lifecycle synchronization and requested-rent override semantics. E13 and E14 highlight a potential conflict: earlier cancellation tolerance language is missing from current rules. The operative context captures the default Requested-status behavior and validation rules directly supported by PRIMARY evidence. Exceptions capture the explicit past-period override clause. Conflicts and gaps are separated to distinguish between obsolete guidance and genuine uncertainties.
